metadata.title: Software stocks rally, with shares of Snowflake surging - MarketWatch

content.text:
21 hours ago
Software stocks rally, with shares of Snowflake surging
Software stocks were rallying Thursday, with shares of Snowflake surging around 20% after the company reported its quarterly earnings results and delivered an artificial-intelligence-fueled forecast that blew past estimates.
The iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF, whose top five holdings as recently as Wednesday included Palantir Technologies, Microsoft, Palo Alto Networks, Salesforce and CrowdStrike Holdings, was up 3.6%, according to FactSet, at last check. The Global X Cloud Computing ETF, whose top holding on Wednesday was Snowflake, was also rallying more than 3%.
